long_biography.plain_text:
George David began his business career in management consulting before joining Otis Elevator. His progression through regional and divisional leadership brought him to the presidency of Otis, then into senior responsibility across United Technologies. As chief executive and chairman, he directed a conglomerate whose operations combined elevators, climate systems, aircraft engines, helicopters and other aerospace technology.

David's wealth is documented through corporate leadership: salary, incentive awards, options and UTC equity accumulated over a long tenure. He was an operator, not the company's founder. His management record centred on international expansion, disciplined processes, research and acquisitions. After handing over executive control, he retired from the board and remained briefly as an adviser, closing more than three decades with the group.
